senses.sense_definition: The act of avoiding the truth or speaking in an evasive way to hide facts.

examples.text: The politician's constant <w>prevarication</w> made it impossible for the reporters to get a straight answer.
After hours of <w>prevarication</w>, the witness finally admitted that he had been at the scene of the crime.

senses.sense_definition: A departure from what is considered morally right or correct behavior.

examples.text: His moral <w>prevarication</w> led him to make choices that hurt his closest friends.
The committee condemned the official for his <w>prevarication</w> regarding the ethical standards of the department.
